defect: design intent asks for finger scallops; they are missing
summary: All hard checks pass and the geometry is clean, but the design_intent 'finger scallops' on the loop are missing — the loop is a plain oblong with no indentations for finger placement.

discrepancies.expected: Loop with finger scallops (two concave indentations along the long edges of the loop opening) so two adult fingers seat positively, as called out in design_intent
discrepancies.observed: Plain oblong hole with uniform straight sides; no scallops or finger-locating features
discrepancies.suggestion: Add two shallow concave scallops (~R10–12 mm, ~1.5–2 mm deep) on the inner long edges of the loop opening, symmetric about the loop center, so each finger has a defined seat. Keep loop_inner_width ≥ 40 mm at the narrowest point between the scallops.
